population_rule: Every manifest test whose ptrace verify cell full validation selects (Population::Required), crossed with every candidate backend (dbt, in-guest-trap, kvm, liteinst, sabre). A candidate whose verify cell is disabled, enabled but not selected, red, refused or missing is in the population and scores 0. A cell whose ptrace reference left no usable golden log is outside it and is counted apart.
